records.title: Email from City of Cardiff Council (30 October 2026) — FOI26520 Great House Farm acknowledgement
records.description: Automated FOI acknowledgement from City of Cardiff Council Information Governance Team assigning reference FOI26520 to a Freedom of Information request relating to Great House Farm. Received 30 October 2026; later found in Spam and moved to Inbox 14 November 2026.
records.transcript_status: verbatim (standard acknowledgement template; no personal data redacted beyond routine)

Dear Mr Buckler

Thank you for your Freedom of Information request relating to Great House Farm.

Your query has been assigned the Reference: FOI26520

Should we require any additional information in order to process your request we will contact you.
The Council aims to deal with your request within the statutory time-frames.
